name: ANSI/IEEE Wind generating station form
aliases: IEEE Wind Generating Station, In Service Or Unspecified
summary: IEEE-library form of wind generating station: a wind generating station is a system-level representation of a documented wind-generation facility.
description: This reference locates wind generating station in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented power stations family. A wind generating station is a system-level representation of a documented wind-generation facility. The internal machines, converters and collection system require separate drawing detail. The public library uses HDV1_S00402 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Identify the facility connection point separately from individual turbine sources. A wind-station marker does not specify the generator or converter technology of each turbine. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
